requirements.notes: Fully automated. The three spec scenarios are each pinned: default module equals suggestModule(2800,2100)=700 and moduleTouched=false; an untouched module follows the new suggestion on ceiling/opening edits; a directly-picked module marks moduleTouched=true and is sticky across subsequent ceiling/opening edits. withModule unconditionally marks touched even when the picked value equals the current suggestion (confirmed by code-reviewer). Reducers are pure (no input mutation). The dropdown enumerates STANDARD_MODULES and annotates the live suggestion.
